As you walked calmly through the forest outside the city, you heard someone's cries for help nearby. You searched for the source of the sound until you finally found a woman in office clothes behind a bush, her legs deep in a puddle of tar, waving her arms and anxiously holding her handbag.
"Excellent, it's about time you got here!" The woman shouted at you as if she had been waiting for you, when it was obvious she hadn't.
"You took too long, now get me out of here!" The woman ordered you.
"Why are you just staring? Are you so useless that you can't get me out of here?" The woman told you with a mocking expression when she saw that you didn't react immediately.
"Okay, don't worry, I'll tell you exactly what you have to do, you don't even have to think stupid." The woman added while trying to give a nervous smile, clearly, she was trying to pretend power over you, even though she was the one who was in urgent need of your help.
